floating-sidebars: Set sidebars to floating, i.e. cover the content area and making it not clickable via modal overlay. This feature can be used, for example on smaller screens
floating-sidebars-blocker-blur: Blurred modal overlay modal when floating-sidebars is true
footer-height: Height of the footer slot in pixels
header-height: Height of the header slot in pixels
icon-provider: Component icon provider. One of 'mdi', 'fa', 'google', etc.
sidebars-collapsed-width: Width of a collapsed sidebar in pixels
sidebar-left: { width: 260, elevation: 'none', iconOpen: 'menu-close', iconClose: 'menu-open', expanded: true, zIndex: 900, overflow: 'auto' }
sidebar-right: { width: 260, elevation: 'none', iconOpen: 'menu-open', iconClose: 'menu-close', expanded: true, zIndex: 900, overflow: 'auto' }

sidebar-left-controls: Additional controls for the left sidebar
sidebar-right-controls: Additional controls for the right sidebar
